notes: Allocations are based on the original 10B SOPH issuance; permanent token burns have since reduced the live supply.

Guardian rewards accrue pro-rata over three years from 2025-01-01. Rewards earned before TGE had a three-month cliff from TGE; each weekly reward after TGE has a three-month cliff followed by seven-day linear vesting, modelled here as a three-month-lagged linear stream.

Node Operators / Guardians.methodology: 20% of the original supply distributed pro-rata to Guardians over three years starting 2025-01-01. Rewards earned before TGE had a three-month cliff from TGE; each weekly reward after TGE has a three-month cliff from the start of its week followed by seven-day linear vesting, modelled as a linear stream lagged by three months.

guardians.name: Node Operators / Guardians
guardians.methodology: Pre-TGE accrued rewards unlock as a cliff three months after TGE; post-TGE rewards vest as a three-month-lagged linear stream until the end of the three-year accrual period.

Post-Mainnet Liquidity Mining.methodology: 2% of the original supply for the L2 Farm. Six-month cliff, then six-month linear vesting.
